policy.bvi_ablation: in-memory Base13 BVI scalar 50 through existing registered derived calculator; DCR unchanged
policy.dedup: each unique observed feature once, category score mean; diagnostic shared dependency is not automatically a bug
policy.history_class_weight: 1/(1+absolute ordinal class distance), unknown=1 with explicit missing flag
policy.history_order: all observed prior races, fixed exponential recency and context similarity
policy.history_surface: exact only; absent or different surface not evidence
policy.information: observation counts remain separate; no DCR removal; unavailable factor leaves baseline unchanged
policy.krs: reuse frozen SSR-W/SSR-P2/SSR-T3 and archived worlds; no simulation/physics/seed change
policy.pair_conditioning: head exclusion/P2 and pair exclusion/P3 except existing frozen head-P2 interaction control

positive_controls.policy: all baseline-correct roles/races retained in denominator; worsening reported, no cherry-picking

probability_readiness.split: existing pre-October24 frozen model/temperature; October24 replay evaluation only
